summary: InnSuites Hospitality Trust filed a Form 8-K reporting results of its 2026 Annual Meeting, including the election of Steven S. Robson as trustee and ratification of BCRG Group as independent accountants. The filing also disclosed strong operating results, record July revenue of $597,323, and continued efforts to seek a reverse merger partner, noting positive discussions and potential high-risk opportunities. No transaction terms, board recommendations, or advisors were disclosed. This is a routine current report; the mention of reverse merger discussions is preliminary and not a definitive special situation. What to watch: any definitive merger agreement or formal strategic review announcement.
